text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompany Admire Vega and
Haru Urara
to a traditional inn. Needless
to say, the reason
being...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
All right, crew! Let's run through the
locations for
the poster photo shoot
tomorrow, shall we?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! ♪ I'm so excited! ♪

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
First off, we'll take a photo here at the
entrance.
After that, we'll do some solo
shots of you two
separately.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
For Urara, I'm thinking of taking photos
of you in the inn's main attraction, the
Sakura Lounge, while you partake in our
cherry blossom-themed
cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Cherry blossom-themed? I wonder what that means! Sounds fun though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
As for Ayabe, I'm thinking it'd be great
if you'd pose in another attraction of the
inn, the Crimson Courtyard. I'd love to
capture you beautifully surrounded in
that world of autumn hues.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
And I'm positive the red accents of the
kimono we've prepared will blend
perfectly with the
autumn leaves! Man, I
can't wait for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll do what I can...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the day of the photo shoot
begins,
but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nooo, it's raining!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame, but there's no changing the
weather. Ayabe, let's scrap our previous
plan and move the
shoot indoors
instead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why? I'm fine getting a little wet.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
No. What if you catch a cold? As your
fan, I couldn't possibly be responsible
for disrupting your race schedule. Don't
worry! I've thought of
other locations.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Like I said—why?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, conditions are never
perfect in a
race—not the track, nor the
weather... not even
my own body.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yet, still, I run. Because none of those
are valid
reasons not to. After all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Running is the decision I made. The same goes for this photo shoot. Plus...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you the one praising how
virtuous it is
that I never go back on my
word?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh right! The owner did say something
like that! I
remember, because it
sounded super cool!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Yeah, you're right. What was I thinking?

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Then, please forget what I said about
changing
our plans. If you are willing,
shall we continue the
photo shoot?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Just let me know when you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, even amid a downpour, the
photo
shoot for the posters featuring
Admire Vega
comes to a successful end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later in the central plaza, I
come across Admire Vega and Haru
Urara surrounded
by a large group of
students.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Urara, I saw your poster in front of the
station!
You were absolutely adorable!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee, you're making me blush!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe, I wanna hear your story too!
Your pictures were so awesome! The one
with you wistfully
standing in the rain
gave me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing really to tell.
I just stood
there
and had my photo taken.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, was it actually raining?! I thought
you had a
race later that same day...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
In defense of the inn, I wasn't troubled
in any
way. Besides, they provided me
with a towel and
heater afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I also... got to use their hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I also... got to use their hot spring.
choice_data_list: I should've hit the hot springs too.
I should've soaked in the hot spri...
Actually, maybe you're cut out to ...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's a little late to be saying that...
choice_data_list: I should've hit the hot springs too.
I should've soaked in the hot spri...
Actually, maybe you're cut out to ...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but the hot spring was so relaxing!

Wouldn't you wanna go again, Ayabe?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...If the opportunity presents itself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If?! Awww, I wanted you to teach me
about the
constellations again.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We could see the stars from the
open-air bath, so Ayabe taught me loads
about constellations! ♪ She had so much
to say about
them!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The constellations I know of just
happened to be
in view, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The photographer was skilled, that's all.

Really?
If that's all it takes for a quality
photo,
then everyone would be a
model. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I saw your poster! ♪ It really, like,
highlights your
strong points, you know?

Haaah ha ha ha! Indubitably so! You
looked
gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Gorgeous to the extent that even I,
beauty
incarnate, could not overlook
you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have heard your declaration of war,
and I shall
respond in kind!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ♪ A declaration of war?! Yeah,
totally! I
won't back down either, then!
I'm feeling a little
pumped! ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Now that we are in accord, shall
we go
settle this photo shoot battle?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm in! ♪ Should we all go to the hot
spring
together?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hey, when did I say I was in on this?!
Can you all
stop dragging me into things
already?!
